From recent orders

Platters, buffet trays and dessert tables plated for real events.

Self taught, cooked from scratch

I am Sammy, and I cook every order myself. What started as cooking for family turned into platters and full catering for other people's celebrations, including a Harry Potter themed party where I ran the whole table.

Nothing is bought in and re plated. The chips are hand cut, the chicken is fried to order and the boards are packed the morning they go out.

  • • Birthdays, baby showers and family gatherings
  • • Office functions and staff lunches
  • • Themed parties, styled to your colours
  • • Dessert tables and grazing boards
